_note: Review pass, November 2026: connections whose relationship turns, checked against the sources (each pair keeps its source).

edit.text: Matt Murdock hides a wounded Vladimir Ranskahov from Fisk's crooked police, and Vladimir, who blames him for his brother's death, attacks him before Matt saves his life. When Matt refuses Fisk's deal to kill him, Vladimir helps Matt escape and stays behind to fight to his death.
edit.whoA: A Russian gangster who blames him, then helps him escape and dies.
edit.whoB: The masked man he blames, who saves his life and refuses to kill him.

pairs.source: MCU Wiki, Vladimir Ranskahov (Condemned): 'Seeing that he was really trying to help him, Ranskahov helped the man escape into a sewer'; relationship listed as 'Former Enemy and Situational Ally'. Matt is never tortured by Vladimir in this episode (Matt seals Vladimir's wound with a flare), so the old text was wrong.

MCU Wiki, Robert Gonzales: May 'stormed into the office... before shooting him with an I.C.E.R.' (AoS 2x15); in 2x16 'Gonzales explained that he was offering May a place on his board of directors'; by 2x19-2x20 she votes on his board and flies with him to Afterlife. At the stage's own episode (S2#20) they are colleagues, so rival was wrong for that episode.

MCU Wiki, Miss Minutes: 'Miss Minutes was eventually reprogrammed and rebooted by Ouroboros, who started her up in the panel room... She resumed her operation of Time Variance Authority technology' (Loki 2x06). The stage text already ends with this, so its kind is changed for the end of Loki S2.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
add.text: To make up for betraying the team, Piper helps S.H.I.E.L.D. track General Hale's phone and stands with Coulson as they capture Hale on the Zephyr, and he praises her work.
add.whoA: An agent who makes amends by helping him capture Hale.
add.whoB: Her director, who praises her for helping capture Hale.

pairs.source: MCU Wiki, Piper: 'Piper helped her allies at S.H.I.E.L.D. to hack into R. Hale's personal phone... Piper stood with Phil Coulson while he complimented Piper on all her good work in helping them capture Hale' (AoS 5x14 'The Devil Complex'); Wikipedia AoS season 5, ep 14: 'Coulson, May, and Agent Piper capture General Hale'.

Wikipedia, AoS season 2, ep 20 'Scars': 'They agree to merge their factions, with Coulson remaining as director and the board acting as his oversight and advisory council'; Gonzales is then killed by Jiaying in the same episode. The stage's own episode ends with them as one S.H.I.E.L.D.

MCU Wiki, Victoria Hand (AoS 1x17 'Turn, Turn, Turn'): 'Hand now believed that Coulson and his team were not agents of Hydra'; she 'reclaimed her base alongside Phil Coulson' and tells him 'All we have is each other... stay in touch', before Ward kills her the same episode.

edit.text: Sidewinder leads SERPENT in a fight with Sam Wilson over stolen adamantium, and later ambushes him on Samuel Sterns' orders. Sam beats him at a salvage yard, and in custody Sidewinder gives up what he knows about Sterns for a reduced sentence.
edit.whoA: SERPENT's leader, who tries to kill him, then gives up Sterns.
edit.whoB: Captain America, who beats him and gets him to talk.

pairs.source: MCU Wiki, Sidewinder: Sterns 'offered to pay him double to kill Captain America. Sidewinder accepted'; Wilson 'kicked him into a car, knocking him out'; in custody 'he settled for a reduced sentence at United States Penitentiary, Allenwood' and vows to kill Sam if he breaks out. They are never on the same side, so the old 'briefly end up on the same side' line was wrong; kind stays enemy.

edit.text: The Silver Surfer, herald of Galactus, announces Earth's doom to Sue and the team, then chases them through space and attacks their bridges. When Galactus reaches New York, she turns on her master and finishes what Sue started, pushing him through the portal herself.
edit.whoA: One of the team she warns of doom, then helps against Galactus.
edit.whoB: Galactus' herald, who turns on him and pushes him through the portal.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, The Fantastic Four: First Steps plot: 'Sue uses all of her power to push him towards the portal with a force field... Johnny attempts to sacrifice himself... but is stopped by Shalla-Bal. She pushes Galactus into the portal herself and it closes behind them.'
